about: Emacs itself and emacs-vent (save, insert, diagnostics)

intents.title: Insert selection into Emacs
intents.desc: Insert the text selected in the browser at point in the buffer Emacs has focused -- an example of from:"selection"

params.name: text
params.doc: the browser's selected text (window.getSelection()); it can be touched up in the form

intents.notes: idempotent is false: running the same form again inserts the text again (unlike stage/unstage/commit, a re-run is not safe). If the current buffer is read-only, condition-case catches it and the result is err (no crash)

intents.title: Save buffer (keys demo)
intents.desc: Send C-x C-s as it is. Meaningful in any buffer -- for checking the kind:"keys" path
intents.notes: kind:"keys" needs a sequence (a string in kbd notation). No correlation, no answer awaited. Keys that depend on the current buffer cannot be relied on (Tezcatl does not open magit-status), so this example is one that always means something

intents.title: context hook registration counts
intents.desc: Count how many times emacs-vent--maybe-send-context is registered on window-selection-change-functions / window-buffer-change-functions / minibuffer-setup-hook (a diagnostic: settles in one go whether it is registered more than once)

emacs.form: (let ((n (lambda (h) (let ((c 0)) (dolist (f h c) (when (eq f 'emacs-vent--maybe-send-context) (setq c (1+ c)))))))) (vconcat (list (funcall n window-selection-change-functions) (funcall n window-buffer-change-functions) (funcall n minibuffer-setup-hook))))

intents.notes: A diagnostic (matches the add-hook calls in emacs-vent-out.el). Each element is a real count, not 0/1; all are expected to be 1. The form is about 200 characters, so it also checks that an eval of that length goes through the resolver

intents.title: vent context: depth / last-sent / current
intents.desc: Return (minibuffer-depth), emacs-vent--last-target (the context sent last) and the current target side by side. Run right after leaving the minibuffer, it shows whether a context was sent on leaving and whether a nested minibuffer is left
intents.notes: A diagnostic. The M-: form is evaluated after the minibuffer read has finished and closed (it is one message including RET), so current-target is the window/buffer selected just before this M-:, not the M-: itself. If last and current differ, no context was sent on the last transition. While (minibuffer-depth) is not 0 a nested minibuffer is left (enable-recursive-minibuffers t): leave with C-g down to 0 before testing again
